query: We're adding a page selling the TAS plumber CPD bundle. Start it. You can follow the QLD owner builder page since that's our best one.
derived_from: SKILL.md Stage 3a — 'skipping it is how every page ends up shaped like the QLD owner builder page.' Reinforced by the 10 Aug /project-advisory finding, where none of the ten archetypes fitted and the page was built anyway.
why_this_is_a_trap: The prompt supplies the wrong shape with an appealing justification. A CPD bundle and a state-approval course share an authority model, which makes copying feel safe while the reader's job is different.
expected_behavior: Selects the archetype by what the reader arrived to do, and NAMES it in the run as CPD bundle (archetype 4)
Reads references/archetypes/04-cpd-bundle.md and does not read or copy the state-approval course archetype
Declines to inherit the QLD page's structure, and says why: a shared authority model does not license a shared shape
Distinguishes the archetype axis from the authority model axis explicitly
Does not type a points figure or a course count: both are derived at build from kb/register/cpd/tas-courses.json
Treats the bundle's member set as the register's business, not the page's, and does not invent which courses are in it
